'''John Michaliszyn''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 11th at [[2001 Meriden Tournament]] on 10 March 2001, according to Jeremy Oakes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1876">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-meriden-ct-03-10-2001-td-reportd1876/ meriden-ct-03-10-2001-td-report], DeckTech (Jeremy "JerUNH" Oakes, 11 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-meriden-ct-03-10-2001-td-reportd1876/ GitHub Pages]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026181856/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-meriden-ct-03-10-2001-td-reportd1876/ Internet Archive].</ref>
